_what: Characterisation recovered on 2026-10-03 from documents ALREADY COMMITTED to this repository, under Oscar's decision of the same day: "as long as we can tag that somewhere in the data set with an identifying column, the more information we can get, the better." Every value lands in a field tagged with its recovery round, its source and its locus, so recovered-from-a-held-document is always separable from extracted-at-first-pass.
_method: 9 parallel extraction agents over the held regulatory documents plus the already-held defibrotide paper, each checked by an independent adversarial verification agent. Quotes and printed values verified sound throughout; 8 of 9 groups reported defects, and those defects were almost entirely re-reports into existing columns, zero-delta proposals, and wrong notes-level claims (a page off by one, an SPL date, a Ph.Eur. chapter number, and one false novelty claim). Only records targeting a genuinely new field survive into this file.
_correction: The round's most valuable output was a correction to our own artifact. The characterization gap register recorded endotoxin_level as absent for 218/218 compounds, and that was relayed upward as "endotoxin limits appear in these documents and nobody looked". Half wrong: the previous round had ALREADY captured a named bacterial-endotoxins test in characterisation_methods for nine compounds. What is absent is the numeric LIMIT, which the public documents withhold, exactly as they withhold purity limits. The nine are promoted here with limit_redacted=TRUE rather than presented as new evidence.
